label: NON_FORMAL_DIAGNOSTIC

classification_rule.broad_based: wide positive distribution, no dominant few dates
classification_rule.concentrated: positive mean, CR5+ > 0.5, >25% dates within 0.01 CNY/day
classification_rule.mixed: different signs across seeds, splits, ESS or legs

recommendation_reason: The gain is concentrated and cost-side. In every primary group the median is within 0.001 CNY/day of zero, the top 5 positive dates carry 52-100% of the positive total, and removing the top 3 positive dates turns both Validation means negative. The positive net comes from lower cycle cost as throughput falls, not from higher market revenue, and Seed 23 final / Validation keeps a 95% CI that includes zero. Day-level quote changes are visible, but the block-level quote-to-clearing chain was not persisted, so the mechanism cannot be verified at the block level. Design work on a new mapping may proceed only after the trace gap is closed by a separately approved run; the current candidate is not a production candidate.
